descriptions.coreArgument: Thanks to the power seat adjustment, the individual setup of the comfort driver's seat can be adjusted at the touch of a button – and thanks to the memory function also very easily restored. This practical function stores the settings of the comfort seats and the height of the luxury head restraint for up to 3 persons.

extendedDescription.headline: Comfortable and steplessly adaptable electric seat adjustment.
extendedDescription.text: When there is a change of driver, your own setup is quickly restored. Added to this are the comfort qualities of the seat during the journey: on the comfort driver's seat occupants of almost any size and stature will find an appropriate seat position and therefore enjoy a pleasant journey even over long distances. The seat can be electrically adjusted in eight ways: fore/aft adjustment for maximum possible legroom, as well as seat height, seat backrest and seat cushion angle adjustment for a comfortable seat position. In addition, the head restraint height can be adjusted electrically and its angle can be adjusted manually. A further plus in comfort is offered by the armrest on the side facing the front passenger.

ingredients.headline: Other features and advantages of the electrically adjustable comfort driver's seat:

ingredients.content: Electric fore/aft adjustment (225 mm in total at 4.5 mm intervals)
Stepless adjustment of the seat backrest angle
Stepless electrical adjustment of seat height
Stepless power adjustment of the seat cushion angle
Luxury head restraint, electrically adjustable for height, manually adjustable for angle
Armrest on the side facing the front passenger
Control element for electrical adjustment of seat settings is located in the door lining near the door opener

descriptions.coreArgument: Thanks to the power seat adjustment, the individual setup of the luxury front passenger seat can be adjusted at the touch of a button – and thanks to the memory function also very easily restored. This practical function stores the settings of the comfort seats and the height of the luxury head restraint for up to 3 persons.

extendedDescription.headline: Comfortable and steplessly adaptable electric seat adjustment.
extendedDescription.text: In the event of a change of occupant on the front passenger seat your own setup can be quickly restored. Added to this are the comfort qualities of the seat during the journey: on the comfort front passenger's seat occupants of almost any size and stature will find an appropriate seat position and therefore enjoy a pleasant journey even over long distances. The seat can be electrically adjusted in eight ways: fore/aft adjustment for maximum possible legroom, as well as seat height, seat backrest and seat cushion angle adjustment for a comfortable seat position. In addition, the head restraint height can be adjusted electrically and its angle can be adjusted manually. The armrest on the side closest to the driver ensures added comfort.

ingredients.headline: Other features and advantages of the electrically adjustable luxury front passenger seat:

ingredients.content: Electric fore/aft adjustment (225 mm in total at 4.5 mm intervals)
Stepless adjustment of the seat backrest angle
Stepless electrical adjustment of seat height
Stepless power adjustment of the seat cushion angle
Luxury head restraint, electrically adjustable for height, manually adjustable for angle
Armrest on the side closest to the driver
Control element for electrical adjustment of seat settings is located in the door lining near the door opener

amendedRecord.evidenceNote: Australian MY2025 technical data effective July 2025 identify eVito Tourer 129 MWB FWD, national type 44770323-AEF. A public AU configurator response observed 11 October 2026 binds the same type to eight seats including the driver (2+3+3), but returns configurationDate 2027-01-11 with unresolved date semantics and no established formal current MY or supply.
limitations: Eight seats including the driver is substantiated only for the exact returned Australian configuration with selected standard SB1/SB2/US4/US5 (2+3+3). Alternative selections were not validated. The overview and electric-vans pages retain incompatible generic eight-occupant, eight-passengers-plus-driver and alternate-layout copy; these broader claims are not silently resolved by this one configuration.

MY2025 / July 2025 technical-sheet applicability must remain separate from the observed configurator response. Its raw 807/057 codes and configurationDate 2027-01-11 do not establish a formal MY, production effectivity or delivery date.

The configurator lists usable battery capacity as 93 kWh while selected ME4/E7T equipment descriptions say 90 kWh. Mass and price fields also require source/epoch qualification; do not combine these with older family-page specifications.

The overview also contains embedded 80 kW DC wording, while the returned E7L equipment and electric-vans table say 110 kW. The older family page range of 430 km uses NEDC. These source and epoch differences must not be normalized into a unified current exact-trim specification.
Current ordering, allocation, delivery and specific New stock remain unverified. The model-page stock link is filtered to diesel Vito people carriers and cannot establish electric Tourer stock.
